result.summary: The page largely renders well, but there are a couple of inconsistencies in the favorite (heart) icon styling and an unusual appearance in the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The favorite heart icons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently. The Tokumaru Ramen card has a plain white outline heart, while the pizza card below has a heart inside a dark filled circle background.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent heart icon treatment (same background/outline style) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar appears visually odd, with a thick horizontal line/bar and overlapping search and bookmark icons in the center, making the active state or icon grouping unclear.
issues.suggestion: Review the bottom navigation rendering to ensure icons are evenly spaced with clear active-state indicators and no overlapping elements.
